text.title: 文件夹里的剪报
text.situation:
诺拉保留一个媒体监测文件夹，剪报旁写有日期和来源链接。新闻界对大厅维修的报道各不相同。一个挑衅性标题暗示志愿者浪费钱以吸引注意，正文却没有为这个说法提供证据。乔把它放在课堂练习用的宣传材料旁，后者刻意只推动一种观点。任何标签都不应成为停止认真阅读的借口。媒体素养课会请读者区分主张、证据和缺失信息，不论刊物看起来多熟悉。文件夹将用于讨论，而不是让所有人照单信任或排斥某家媒体。

乔：媒体监测和控制新闻界一样吗？
诺拉：这里不是，我们在跟踪报道、核查内容。
乔：那读者应该能看到原链接。

paragraphs.en: Nora kept a folder for media monitoring, with dates and source links beside the cuttings. The press had covered the hall repairs in different ways. One provocative headline had attracted attention by suggesting that volunteers were wasting money, although the article offered no evidence for that claim. Jo put it beside a piece of propaganda from a classroom exercise, which had been designed to promote only one view. Neither label was an excuse to stop reading carefully. Their media literacy education session would ask readers to separate claims, evidence and missing information, irrespective of how familiar a publication looked. The folder would be used for discussion, not as a list of outlets everyone had to trust or reject.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is media monitoring the same as controlling the press?
Nora: Not here. We are tracking coverage and checking what it says.
Jo: Then the readers should see the original links.

S16.N15.P03.cue: 说说怎样对待熟悉外观和挑衅标题。
